news.title: Atlanta man dies after fight outside Nashville bar
news.summary: Torey Ward, a 45-year-old Atlanta man, died after a physical altercation outside a bar on 2nd Avenue North in downtown Nashville at about 2:30 a.m. Oct. 25, Nashville police said.

news.title: Demolition begins at former Elleven45 Lounge in Buckhead
news.summary: Demolition is underway at the former Buckhead lounge, where a Mother’s Day 2024 shooting killed two people and injured four.

news.title: Former College Park police chief files federal lawsuit
news.summary: Former Police Chief Connie Rogers is suing the city, alleging discrimination based on her sexual orientation and retaliation.

news.title: Child found dead during welfare check, police unable to find family
news.summary: Atlanta police have confirmed that officers are investigating the death of a child near Cardinal Drive SW.

news.title: Child found dead inside southwest Atlanta home after welfare check, police say
news.summary: Police have not released the child's identity or exact age, describing the victim only as a young child.

news.title: Woman arrested in Coweta after stealing U.S. Postal Service van
news.summary: A woman is facing state and federal charges after allegedly stealing an unoccupied U.S. Postal Service mail truck in Columbus and driving it 80 miles to metro Atlanta before being caught.

news.title: Newnan businessman sentenced to 15 years in $76M Ponzi scheme
news.summary: A 69-year-old Newnan man will spend 15 years in federal prison after defrauding more than 300 investors out of $76 million in a massive Ponzi scheme, according to federal prosecutors.

news.title: New details emerge in fatal Newnan police chase
news.summary: The Coweta Judicial Circuit District Attorney's Office disclosed new evidence Monday regarding the police shooting of 18-year-old Zadarious Dorsey.

news.title: Man with gunshot wound walks into Atlanta Police precinct after being shot at nearby park
news.summary: APD said a man walked into their Zone 4 precinct with a gunshot wound on Mon. An 11Alive crew found the crime scene at Howell Park.

news.title: Young woman, daughter found shot to death in Cobb County church parking lot
news.summary: The Cobb County Police Department has not identified the two individuals and say there are no suspects outstanding at this time in the investigation.

news.title: Woman charged with felony murder in deadly overdose at Lawrenceville home, police say
news.summary: Officers responded to the home for a reported overdose and found the victim, who was pronounced dead.

news.title: Man arrested on sexual battery charges after alleged groping spree in Midtown Atlanta
news.summary: The Atlanta Police Department say 33-year-olt Timothy Quarles faces three counts of sexual battery of the allegations from October 15
